extension_description.message: Real-time 2x+ frame interpolation with custom target FPS for any <video>. Runs locally on your GPU with WebGPU.

language_hint.message: Uses the browser language by default.

language_save_failed.message: Could not save the language preference.

generation_desc.message: How many frames are generated and how they are paced.

generation_hint.message: Generate in-between frames while a video plays.

output_hint.message: Auto picks the smoothest rate your display and GPU can hold.

custom_hint.message: 2–1000. Stays at least 2× the source and within what the display and GPU allow.

fps_limit_hint.message: A ceiling for Auto. It may run lower to stay smooth.

full_refresh_hint.message: Use the display's measured refresh rate instead of 97% of it.

limit_display_hint.message: Never generate more frames than the screen can show. Off: generate as many as the GPU allows; the counter then reports generated frames.

motion_auto_hint.message: Auto generates fewer frames on fast scenes, where artifacts would show. Off: always the highest rate the GPU allows.

quality_hint.message: The size the network runs at. Balanced is its native scale; higher costs more GPU time and rarely looks better.

motion_desc.message: How generated frames handle animation, patterns and on-screen text.

animation_hint.message: For drawn content: frames the animation repeats are not blended into the next drawing.

cadence_hint.message: With Animation mode. Spreads animation drawn on twos and threes evenly over the frames each drawing is held for, so motion slides instead of stepping. Every shown frame is then generated; can look soft or wrong on fast action.

pattern_hint.message: Re-checks motion on fences, railings and window grids, which can double during pans. Stronger with Animation mode. Small GPU cost.

subtitle_guard_hint.message: Burnt-in subtitles, logos and HUDs are taken from the source frames instead of moving with the picture behind them.

sharper_edges_hint.message: Bicubic sampling for generated frames: crisper edges, hair and texture. About 0.2 ms per generated frame.

picture_desc.message: Looks and image processing applied to what you see.

picture_mode_hint.message: A color and detail look on top of the video. Detail Boost sharpens and adds the 2× upscale where it applies.

sharpness_hint.message: Edge enhancement. High can create halos.

upscale_hint.message: 2× neural upscaling when the player is larger than the video.

hdr_hint.message: Brighter highlights on an HDR display.

player_desc.message: What Framegen shows over the video.

hover_hint.message: Show the Framegen buttons when the pointer is over a video.

fps_counter_hint.message: Output frame rate and render time in the corner.

watermark_hint.message: The Framegen label while generation is on.

warnings_hint.message: Performance notices. Errors are always shown.

subtitle_overlay_hint.message: Keep the player's subtitles above generated frames.

diagnostics_desc.message: Tools for checking what Framegen does.

compare_hint.message: Split view: the original on the left, the processed picture on the right.

debug_hint.message: A border around the processed area and detailed runtime numbers.

delete_profile_generic.message: This profile will be removed. Current video settings will stay unchanged.

webgpu_help_intro.message: WebGPU is switched off in the browser. In Chrome:

driver_update.message: Still nothing? Update the GPU driver from NVIDIA/AMD/Intel - old drivers get blocklisted.

laptop_gpus_hint.message: Browsers on Windows often land on the integrated GPU - fps barely improves.

check_gpu.message: Check: the GPU line on the Status tab should show the discrete card.

requirements_hint.message: Desktop Chrome or Edge 121+, or Firefox 142+ on Windows, and a GPU from roughly 2016 or newer. Safari and phones - no.

how_to_use_hint.message: Hover any video: the FG (on/off), picture and settings buttons appear on its left edge. Compare, an original/processed split view, is in the full settings.

limitations_hint.message: Netflix, Crunchyroll and other DRM sites - the browser never hands us their pixels, a platform limitation. On some sites the video may reload for a couple of seconds the first time you enable FG (CORS) - that is normal.

auto_limit_short_hint.message: Common rates · Auto may run lower

fps_counter_short_hint.message: Show frame rate and render time

watermark_short_hint.message: Show the Framegen label on video

profile_schema_unsupported.message: This version of Framegen does not support profile format {version}.

custom_fps_range.message: Enter a Custom FPS from 2 to 1000

delete_profile_named.message: “{name}” will be removed. Current video settings will stay unchanged.

popup_blocked.message: Framegen is blocked on this site

popup_gpu_missing_hint.message: Check that graphics acceleration is enabled in your browser.

popup_integrated.message: The browser is using the integrated GPU.

reload_updated.message: Reload the page: Framegen was updated

settings_from_toolbar.message: Open settings from the toolbar icon

blocked_wasm.message: This site's security policy forbids WebAssembly for extensions, so Framegen cannot run here

gpu_help.message: WebGPU is off. Enable "Use graphics acceleration" in the browser settings, restart the browser and update the GPU driver. Very old GPUs are not supported.

no_adapter_help.message: The browser gives WebGPU no GPU right now. Restart the browser (after a driver reset, for example when a game crashed, it stays off until then); if it persists, check that WebGPU is hardware accelerated on chrome://gpu and update the GPU driver.

cors_reload.message: Framegen: the video lacks CORS, reloading it

integrated_advice.message: The browser is using the integrated GPU ({gpu}). In Windows Settings → Display → Graphics, choose High performance for the browser, then restart it.

cors_unreadable.message: Framegen: the video is not readable (CORS)

redraw_failed.message: Framegen: could not redraw the paused video

gpu_recovery_failed.message: Framegen: GPU recovery failed, reload this page

state_invalid_target.message: Target FPS must be a positive number

state_no_two_x_display.message: Display refresh rate is below the minimum needed for frame generation

state_no_two_x_gpu.message: GPU cannot sustain the minimum FPS at this quality

warning_gpu_clamp.message: {requested} FPS capped to {output} FPS at this quality

warning_old_firefox.message: This Firefox version is too old for smooth frame generation: update Firefox

warning_drops.message: Frames are dropping: lower the output rate or the quality, or switch to Auto

warning_auto_gpu.message: The GPU cannot keep up even at 2x: lower the quality

warning_fixed_gpu.message: The GPU sustains {actual}× at this quality, not {requested}×

kick_rewind.message: Kick restarted the stream from the beginning: back at {time}
